name: SolidCraft CAD
description: Headless parametric 3D CAD (SolidCraft, open source, written in Rust). Design mechanical parts from sketches, extrusions, primitives, holes and fillets, measure them, render PNG previews and export STL, STEP, 3MF, OBJ, GLB or IGES. Opens .sc designs, STEP and mesh files from /work.
instructions:
SolidCraft runs headless in your own container; every file lives in /work.

1. Read the modeling guide first: skill_reference {"skill":"solidcraft-modeling"} (units are mm and degrees, Z is up). For an existing file, upload it to /work and call open {"path":"/work/part.step"} (also .sc, .stl, .3mf, .obj, .glb).
2. Plan the numbers (parameters, expected volume and bounding box), then build the part in a few batch calls with verbose:false and expect {volume_mm3, bbox}. Simple blocks, bosses and holes are cheapest as solid.box / solid.cylinder / solid.hole. Use list_commands {"filter": ...} and describe_command for command parameters; never list all commands unfiltered.
3. Check the result with measure or inspect_design, and look at it with screenshot {"view":"iso"}: it saves a PNG into /work and returns its path (no inline image).
4. Save the design after each stage: save {"path":"/work/<name>.sc"}. A new MCP session (e.g. after a reconnect) starts with an empty design, so reopen the .sc file then.
5. Export what the user needs: export {"path":"/work/<name>.stl"} for 3D printing, /work/<name>.step for CAD, also .3mf, .obj, .glb.
6. Hand the files over: download them from /work with plugin_download_file (STL/GLB for a 3D preview, PNG screenshots to show the part, the .sc to continue later).

All paths must be inside /work; relative paths resolve against /work. The container and /work are deleted after the conversation is idle, so always download the results.

accepts.description: SolidCraft design to open and edit
STEP model (.step/.stp) to open as a new design
STL mesh to open as mesh bodies
3MF mesh to open as mesh bodies
OBJ mesh to open as mesh bodies
glTF binary to open as mesh bodies

returns.description: glTF binary with colours, for 3D previews
SolidCraft design to continue editing later
